$comment: Golden cases of the guild window (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py; P16 spec 5.9.8, 12): one case per page, each built by the controller from the fixtures' guild (tools/nui_w4_fixtures.py): the info page of a level 15 guild whose master is the tester (the mark, symbol and war buttons show), two enemies, the large mark from the guild war fixture atlas; board: 12 comments, two notices (a bar, the '!' gone, as legacy), one longer than 35 characters cut with '...'; member: legacy's 13-line window over 30 members with its scroll bar, the master's combo box disabled; member-open: line 4's grade list open under its combo box, over the lines and the tabs below it, as legacy's top-most list (tools/nui_hit_test.py lets the list take the presses on what it covers); base: legacy's placeholders (its tab stays disabled, D9); skill: the six active skills at levels 0 to 7 with their '+' (2 points), the passive row and the affect grid empty, the dragon power at 40 of 100 (classic: legacy's cut of its frame art), also under reduced motion and with effects off; grade: 15 grades, grade 1 disabled; foundation: a 24-character guild and enemy names, 88 of 88 members of a level 20 guild; foundation-member: 22-character member names; translucent: modern-dark and modern-light at 80% panel opacity over the synthetic backdrop. Its classic art is in assets/ETC, the tab art in assets/locale; screen: the info page on the test screen (1600x900; 1920x1080 at 200%, where the window is taller than 900) at 100, 150, 200% and the automatic scale, centered as the client centers it at its first open (P18), every look, and screen-translucent the same at 100% in the translucent look.
